items.headline: NFL suspends Rams' Alaric Jackson for two games after punch
items.description: The NFL on Tuesday suspended Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson for two games without pay after he punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb following Monday night's game in Los Angeles.

items.headline: Sources: Rams release kicker Mevis after miscues in loss, sign Grupe from Jets
